hash_47d7f89fe5a09326: ^1SCP-049: ^7Ah, I wasn't aware we had company. We rarely get visitors down here.
hash_e8c79d9a5212fca: ^1SCP-049: ^7Do not be afraid, I am the cure.
hash_99ccec71e76009d: ^1SCP-049: ^7Ring-a-ring o' roses. A pocket full of posies. A-tishoo! A-tishoo! We all fall down.
hash_467cdc55298ddceb: ^1SCP-049: ^7Oh my, yet another victim of the disease.
hash_778669b0220a5595: ^1SCP-049: ^7Good heavens. It's worse than I thought. Like wildfire, it spreads. They should have brought me here sooner.
hash_3124a2855ab13da5: ^1SCP-049: ^7I need to get to work before the disease consumes the rest of these poor souls.
hash_4602f7408057dcd6: ^1SCP-049: ^7Stop resisting, I am here to cure you.
hash_72429c219b32066f: ^1SCP-049: ^7Let's get this strange garment out of the way.
